OpenCode Guard List

Put one folder or file per line under a heading. Drag it in from Finder or type a
path starting with / or ~. Delete a line to remove it. Lines starting with # are
ignored. Save, then quit and reopen OpenCode.

When entries overlap, DENY always wins; otherwise the most specific entry wins.
OpenCode can always write its own data, caches and temp files; the full list of
what applied is in last-launch.log next to this file. Build tools with their own
folders in your home, such as ~/.cargo or ~/go, need those folders under ALLOW.

ALLOW - agents may create, change and delete things inside these:

READ ONLY - agents may look but never change or delete:

DENY - agents may not read, search, change or delete these:
# Examples; remove the # to use. Denying these breaks git over SSH and cloud tools inside the guard.
# ~/.ssh
# ~/.aws
# ~/.gnupg
